facets.description: EmbeddableHostsController#update: where(id:).first can return nil and is passed to save_host, giving a 500 instead of a 404
EmbeddableHostsController#destroy: where(id:).first can return nil and host.destroy is called on it, giving a 500 instead of a 404
EmbeddableHost before_validation calls host.sub! on a possibly nil host, raising NoMethodError
EmbeddableHost.record_for_host compares lower(host) against a uri.host that is not downcased, so mixed-case referers are rejected
